```{r bib-data}
#| output: false
if(!require(RefManageR))
  remotes::install_github("ropensci/RefManageR") 
RefManageR::BibOptions(check.entries = FALSE, style = "markdown", bib.style = "numeric", max.names=99)
#Sys.setlocale(category = "LC_ALL", locale="en_US.UTF-8")
bib <- RefManageR::ReadBib("dfolio.bib", .Encoding = "UTF-8", check = 'warn')
bibACL<-bib[c(bibtype="Article",entrysubtype="!ACLN")]
bibDO<-bib[entrysubtype="DO"]
bibOS<-bib[entrysubtype="OS"]
bibACT<-bib[bibtype="InProceedings"] 
```
 
My scientific activities have led to `r length(bib)` publications,
including [`r length(bibACL)` articles](#ACL) (ACL), 
[`r length(bibDO)` guest editorial](#DO) (DO), 
[`r length(bibOS)`  books chapter](#OS) (OS) and 
[`r length(bibACT)` proceedings](#ACT) (ACT).

Most of the documents hereafter are also shared or listed on the following academic social networks and scholarly literature databases:

You may also be interested in the [publications page](../publications/index.qmd) where some of the documents below are shared.

:::{.callout-tip}
- The publications list here follows the Hcéres[^1] proposed nomenclature.
- Two journal metrics are reported here: journal quartile (Qn) and impact factor (IF).
:::

[^1]: From French "*[Haut Conseil de l'évaluation de la recherche et de l'enseignement supérieur]{.fr lang="fr"}*" (Hcéres) which is the High Council for Evaluation of Research and Higher Education an independent administrative authority. <https://www.hceres.fr>
